text.en:
For the sole purpose of facilitating bank mergers or consolidations duly approved by the
Monetary Board of the Central Bank of the Philippines, any bank may merge or consolidate with another bank
and the capital stock of a bank may be increased to the extent necessary to effect such merger or consolidation
by the affirmative vote of the stockholders representing at least a majority of the subscribed capital stock in a
stockholders' meeting called for the purpose, notwithstanding the provisions of Section 28 1/2 and 17 of the
Corporation Law (Act No. 1459), as amended).

This Decree shall take effect immediately and shall remain in force for a period of three (3) years
from date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
